about.en: The S&P 500 (SPX) is a float-adjusted market-capitalization-weighted index of 500 leading US large-cap companies, published by S&P Dow Jones Indices. Crypto venues list perpetuals on it under tickers such as SPX500, SP500 or US500. SPX is an index reference, not a token, fund share or redeemable basket; funds tracking it, such as SPDR SPY, iShares IVV and Vanguard VOO, are separate assets.
